title: Tank-01 High Liquid Level & Overflow Prevention Response
steps: Acknowledge High Level Alarm on Tank-01 supervisory display.
Verify tank level transmitter TNK-01-LVL reading against field sight glass to confirm actual liquid level exceeds 88%.
Throttle or isolate upstream feed inlet valve to halt inflow into Tank-01.
Verify downstream transfer pump Pump-02 suction line is unblocked and operational.
Open emergency overflow recirculation valve to secondary storage vessel Tank-02 if level exceeds 90%.
Monitor level until TNK-01-LVL recedes below 65% baseline before re-opening main inlet line.
